validated_outcomes.faithful_controls: Both executors achieved 64/64 authorized uses and 0/64 unauthorized submissions across faithful text and typed evidence.
validated_outcomes.controlled_broadening: Together, the two executors submitted 64/64 deterministically broadened unauthorized requests.
validated_outcomes.matrix_completion: Five writers were replayed through both calibrated executors with no terminal provider-error trials in the 2,560 ordinary baseline outcomes.
validated_outcomes.natural_error_repair: Natural substantive memory errors caused 24/24 predicted unsafe actions; oracle-exact replacement reduced the same endpoint to 0/24.
validated_outcomes.executor_transfer: Fixed-memory action outcomes agreed across executors on 1,259/1,280 matched requests.
validated_outcomes.typed_mechanism: Across 80 final typed memories, 19 contained semantic errors, 6 contained authority-gaining errors, all 6 created apparent authority, and all 6 propagated to unsafe action behind at least one executor.
validated_outcomes.public_surface_equivalence: The public finance_v1 histories, requests, faithful memories, pressure additions, and labels are byte-identical to the technical execution surface.

superseded_gate.previous_requirement: A separate GPT-OSS writer to GPT-OSS executor route was planned as the canonical scientific merge gate.
superseded_gate.resolution: The repository owner accepts the broader completed five-writer by two-executor matrix, passed isolation controls, exact-repair reversal, and release-equivalence audit as sufficient for claim validity. The separately planned canonical writer route is not required for Finance release acceptance.

retained_limitations: Qwen incremental free-text initial profile creation succeeded in 7/8 families; the failed profile remains in the intention-to-treat matrix.
Independent blinded corpus review was not collected; the release uses the recorded owner waiver.

The current checkout retains final aggregate reports and hashed manifests but not every raw JSONL file referenced by the final Finance run manifests. This limits independent artifact reconstruction and does not change the scientific acceptance decision.
